description: Only genuine Unity captures with recorded provenance are displayed. The manual builder emits an explicit pending state for a missing capture.

items.title: Choice_Forrest + Landscape prefab
items.summary: Actual Choice_Forrest rendering with the bundled Assets/Prefabs/Landscape.prefab instantiated by the capture fixture to supply ground and forest. This is a source customization, not the default scene or a compact-player preset.

items.title: Terrain beneath the Milky Way
items.summary: Authored terrain and an automatically generated astronomical sky. The sky manifest identifies its observer location and represented time.

items.title: Terrain and a panoramic background
items.summary: Homing-style visual context combines authored terrain with an explicit panorama. A panorama background does not define navigable geometry.

items.title: Choice bars
items.summary: Configured bar stimuli in the existing Choice controller family; positions and appearance belong to the experiment JSON.

items.title: Optomotor drum
items.summary: The rotating grating/drum path owns stimulus motion and records its stimulus parameters.

items.title: Stripe fixation recipe
items.summary: A stripe/fixation configuration uses the existing controller and registered visual assets rather than requiring a separate scene per parameter.

items.title: Objects and landmarks
items.summary: A configured set of object stimuli with explicit pose/appearance and the active tracking/reset choices.

items.title: Locust swarm
items.summary: Virtual agent populations rendered around an animal-controlled rig, with independent agent motion and per-rig visibility.

items.title: Kannadi — the mirror matrix
items.summary: ಕನ್ನಡಿ means mirror in Kannada. The scene replicates tracked animal poses across a hexagonal matrix with configured self/peer viewing.
